# 🚨 WE ARE HIRING 🚨

We are actively expanding the **Redwood City** team and are currently looking for motivated and professional individuals to help build and maintain the project.

Open positions include:

<:Developer:1458455138862628886>  **Developers**  
Developers work directly on the game itself, including systems, gameplay features, performance, UI, and core mechanics. This role is for experienced, dedicated people who can contribute long-term to a high-quality project.

<:Support:1458455171523940454>  **Game Support Team**  
Game Support members handle bug reports and suggestions submitted by the community. They ensure reports are complete, organized, and properly forwarded to leadership and developers. This role is essential for keeping communication between players and the dev team clean and efficient.

<:Contributor:1458455214985052324>  **Contributors**  
Contributors assist the project with specific skills such as translation, music, sound design, art, or other creative contributions. This role is flexible and ideal for specialists who want to help improve the overall quality of the game.

<:Moderator:1458455317464613027>  **In-Game Moderators**  
Moderators help maintain a fair, safe, and enjoyable environment in-game. They enforce rules, handle disruptive behavior, and assist players when needed, ensuring a professional and welcoming experience for everyone.

All positions are reviewed carefully. We value professionalism, maturity, and commitment over rushed or low-effort applications.

If you’re interested, keep an eye on the https://discord.com/channels/1446500024736546939/1458110641679372543 channel and the https://discord.com/channels/1446500024736546939/1446927281162424543 channel for when applications are open.
